thread:
IncidentBot: ⚠️ realtime-latency-monitor detected sustained p99 spike on /v1/stream (SLO breach)
IncidentBot: alert_id=rlm-20270314-01, current_p95=480ms, current_p99=2.1s, threshold_p99=1.2s, affected_region=us-west-2
Maria K: oncall taking this. paging Ashwin. 
Maria K: @Ashwin R can you grab traces and see if it's model-side or network?
Ashwin R: looking. pulling dashboard now — p95 jumped ~200ms at 14:03 UTC, p99 tail has multiple 5-10s outliers.
Jules N: seeing a bunch of streaming stalls in tail traces, lots of stalled send() on the runtime.
Kai L: I can check infra: node-level CPU/GPU usage, NVLink errors, NIC drops. starting `grafana -> infra -> gpu-pool`
Ashwin R: quick logs query: `logs query "endpoint:/v1/stream AND level:warn AND event:stall" | count by node` shows spikes on node-gpu-05 and node-gpu-09
Ashwin R: stack traces show long KV cache misses and repeated model retries 
Maria K: are we seeing any rollout or new model version?
deploy-bot: deploy event: canary rollout of model-rev-3b @ 13:58 UTC by jules — 20% traffic routed
Jules N: yeah I pushed a canary earlier to validate perf on longer sequences. it passed local perf tests.
Ashwin R: correlating — spike starts ~5m after canary ramp. canary nodes match node-gpu-09.
Kai L: infra metrics: node-gpu-09 has transient GPU memory fragmentation + occasional process OOM kill attempts (kube evictions) but still running. NIC stats clean.
Maria K: initial hypothesis: canary model variant has different KV cache behavior causing stalls under streaming workload -> elevated tail.
Ashwin R: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback canary to route traffic off model-rev-3b, 2) increase autoscale for streaming pool, 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model-rev-2a for streaming paths.
Maria K: do rollback first, then autoscale if needed. Jules, can you rollback canary now?
Jules N: rolling back canary -> executing: `redwood deploy rollback --model model-rev-3b --traffic 0`
deploy-bot: rollback started (id rb-20270314-01). expected propagation ~30s-90s.
Ashwin R: watching p99 in dashboard...
Kai L: scaling up streaming pool by +2 nodes as safety: `infractl scale --pool streaming --add 2`
Maria K: noted; make sure we don't trigger noisy autoscale — short burst only. Kai: put autoscale min back after.
Kai L: done. nodes added, warm-up in progress.
Ashwin R: p99 dropping — 2.1s -> 1.3s within 60s. p95 back to baseline ~180ms. still a few residual >3s tails.
Maria K: good. Ashwin, run a few synthetic stream requests and check tail traces for any lingering stalls.
Ashwin R: running synthetic tests against /v1/stream with long context (4k tokens). one sample still hit 4.7s stall, trace attached: `trace-id: t-179999-01` 
Jules N: digging into model changes: model-rev-3b added a different KV prefetch policy; might be thrashing under long streaming KV lookups.
Maria K: impact assessment: partial SLO breach for ~7m window, affected ~8% of global streaming requests (us-west primary). No customer-visible errors (responses eventually completed), but elevated latency > p99 threshold.
Maria K: I’m paging SRE lead for postmortem. Immediate owner: Ashwin + Jules.
Ashwin R: followups to capture: - collect flame graphs of runtime during incident - export KV cache hit-rate heatmaps - capture model config diff between rev-2a and rev-3b
Jules N: will add model telemetry and revert the prefetch change in a patch; will run canary with synthetic long-seq tests before re-ramp.
Kai L: infra action items: mark node-gpu-09 for deeper forensic, capture GPU memory allocator logs, and clear any fragmentation by restart if needed.
Maria K: mitigation summary: rollback canary => traffic off model-rev-3b, temporary scale +2 nodes => p99 returned near baseline. Incident severity: sev3 (SLO hit but no customer errors).
Maria K: creating incident ticket: INC-20270314-rlm. assigning Ashwin/Jules/Kai for next steps.
Ashwin R: saving dashboard snapshots and trace links. pls add any extra notes to ticket.
Jules N: thanks all. will validate patch and re-run canary in staging with long-stream workload.
Maria K: handing off to oncall follow-up. I’ll be available if it recurs in next 30m. :pager:
